cited_by.title: Choosing a stylist, braider or loctician

record.finding: 78.9% had never heard of lichen planopilaris and 57.9% had never heard of CCCA. All reported avoiding or limiting tight braids or locs and tight ponytails or buns; 89.5% avoided tight weaves. 94.7% (18 of 19) had referred a client to a dermatologist in the past year. The authors say there are gaps in knowledge of hair loss risk factors.
record.note: Tiny self-selected survey; says nothing about outcomes of using a trained stylist.
